property_summary: After seedMarket sets initialized to true, initialized must remain true (observable via reverts in functions that require it).
After a successful seedMarket call, calling collectDrugs with any address must not revert (it requires initialized).
seedMarket setting of initialized correlates with its ability to revert on collectDrugs before getFreeKilo
Calling DrugDealer by any non-deployer after the original deployer has already called it once reverts on P but succeeds on M.
The first call to DrugDealer succeeds and the second call to DrugDealer fails (reverts).
DrugDealer() can only be called exactly once by the deployer (ceoAddress), and any second call must revert.
DrugDealer() can only be called exactly once by the deployer (ceoAddress), and any second call must revert.
DrugDealer() can only be called exactly once by the deployer (ceoAddress), and any second call must revert.
After initialization, calling DrugDealer() from a non-CEO address must not change ceoAddress; the buggy version allows any caller to become CEO.

After a call to DrugDealer() from any address other than the contract's deployer (the implicit sender in setUp), ceoAddress must remain the deployer's address; the buggy version allows any caller to update ceoAddress.
After initialization, a call to DrugDealer() from any address other than the current ceoAddress must leave ceoAddress unchanged; the buggy version allows any caller to become ceoAddress.
Only a single address pre-assigned during construction can change ceoAddress; any other address that attempts to do so must revert.
Only an address equal to the current ceoAddress can successfully call DrugDealer without reverting.
